attempts.diagnosis: TestSearch's precondition only requires sortedness for pairs where j < a.Length - 1, so it does not cover the final pair of elements. BinarySearch requires the entire array to be sorted for all j < a.Length. Therefore Dafny cannot prove BinarySearch's sortedness precondition at the call in TestSearch; the counterexample shows the last two elements out of order while still satisfying TestSearch's weaker precondition.
attempts.repair: requires forall i, j :: 0 <= i < j < a.Length ==> a[i] <= a[j];
